subject: Request: 72h telemetry soak — sandbox credit window
messages:
From: Sam Li <sam@signalmesh.co>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: platformops@signalmesh.co
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox credit window for 72h telemetry soak

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. We ran the initial cold-start tests and want to follow up with a controlled 72-hour telemetry soak to validate tail latency and KV cache behavior under sustained load.

Plan summary (attached): signalmesh_load_plan.xlsx — 72h run, ramp to 5k qps (short bursts to 8k), mixed prompt lengths (average 120 tokens, 95th at ~600). We also attached a short telemetry sample (telemetry_sample_log.txt) from our staging run.

Request: Can Redwood provision an ephemeral sandbox credit window (non-billable) that covers ~50k request-units / equivalent token budget for this 72-hour run? We need it to be available starting Friday, May 17 at 00:00 PDT.

Acceptance criteria: minimal-request failures <0.1%, p95 latency < 350ms for short prompts, successful KV warm-cache hit-rate > 80%.

We can share a short mutual action plan and notify you of exact start time once provisioning is confirmed. Happy to jump on a 15m call if it helps.

Thanks,
Sam Li
SignalMesh — Platform Reliability
(sam@signalmesh.co)

Attachments: signalmesh_load_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), telemetry_sample_log.txt (text)
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Li <sam@signalmesh.co>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox credit window for 72h telemetry soak

Ben / Neha — looping you in. SignalMesh (Sam) is asking for a 72-hour, ephemeral sandbox credit window to run a telemetry soak. Details attached by Sam. Key asks: ~50k unit budget, start Fri 5/17 00:00 PDT, acceptance criteria listed in the plan.

Sam — thanks for the clear plan. Quick internal notes: we prefer to provision as a sandbox voucher tied to the account with a strict expiration and telemetry hook back to our console so we can capture token breakdown and tail latencies.

Ben — can you confirm whether this fits under our promotional sandbox policy or if this needs a manual credit approval? If manual, what's the estimate to turn around?

Neha — if approved, please send the standard approval confirmation and any procurement notes to Sam; they may need a PO or billing hold documented for their security/compliance folks.

If easier, I can stand up a 15m call tomorrow with all parties.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

Sam / Ava / Neha —

We can approve a provisional sandbox voucher to cover the requested 72-hour soak. Summary of the approval: 50k unit voucher (non-billable), valid from 2028-05-17T00:00:00-07:00 to 2028-05-20T00:00:00-07:00. Voucher will be applied to the SignalMesh test account (signalmesh-test@signalmesh.co).

Operational notes:
- Voucher will be provisioned with telemetry hooks to our Console (route: /orgs/signalmesh/bench-0587) so our observability team can capture token-level latencies for the run.

- Please include contact details for an on-call engineer (preferably one of your platformops emails) for quick troubleshooting.

Neha — please prepare the credit confirmation email and any documentation; also confirm whether SignalMesh needs a billing hold or PO for internal approvals. If procurement requires, we can provide a short credit-endorsement letter.

Sam — can you confirm the exact account email you want the voucher applied to and confirm on-call contact? Once I have that, I’ll request provisioning and send a confirmation with voucher id.

—Ben
